data.title: Copyright infringement warning letter (Abmahnung) – settlement demand
data.case_title: Copyright infringement warning letter (Abmahnung) from Kanzlei Dr. Beispielmann
data.summary: A law firm (Kanzlei Dr. Beispielmann & Coll. Medienrecht) in Düsseldorf sent a copyright infringement warning letter (Abmahnung) dated 18 November 2026, claiming that a film was offered for download via a file-sharing network over the recipient's internet connection, and demanding a lump-sum settlement of €1,180.00 to be paid by 1 December 2026 to avoid a lawsuit.
data.explanation: This is a private law firm's demand letter alleging illegal file-sharing (copyright infringement) over your internet connection, asking you to pay a settlement of €1,180.00 instead of being sued. It does not come from a court. Because money is claimed and the payment deadline shown by the app is very close, it is worth acting quickly: do not simply pay without checking the claim, since such letters are sometimes sent broadly or with inflated amounts, and the IBAN given does not pass the normal validity check. Consider getting independent legal advice from a lawyer specialising in copyright/IT law before responding or paying, and keep a copy of this letter and any correspondence.
